title: The 10MB PDF limit is advertised in the UI and never enforced anywhere
detail: handleFileChange validates MIME type only. A 50MB PDF is accepted, base64-encoded on the main thread (freezing the tab), sent inline to Gemini, rejected with a 400, and then reported to the user as 'That API key was rejected' via the S005 mapping. Three defects chain into a message that sends the user off to regenerate a perfectly good key.

title: The PDF drop zone cannot be reached or activated by keyboard
detail: It is a bare <div onClick> wrapping a hidden file input — no role, no tabIndex, no key handler. Keyboard and screen-reader users cannot upload a PDF at all.

title: Rejecting a file leaves the previous valid file selected and submittable
detail: The else branch sets an error but never clears `file`. Pick a good PDF, then pick a .docx: the error says the file is invalid while the submit button stays enabled and uploads the earlier PDF.

title: Rating input accepts any number despite min/max
detail: onChange does Number(e.target.value) with no clamp. Browsers do not block out-of-range typing on number inputs, and an emptied field yields 0, so ratings of 0 or 99 are persisted and rendered as stars.

title: convertFileToBase64 assumes a well-formed data URL
detail: `(reader.result as string).split(',')[1]` yields undefined if the read produces null or a non-data-URL, and that undefined is passed straight into the Gemini request as inline data.

title: A PDF is held three times over during upload
detail: The File, its base64 string (~1.37x), and later the stored ArrayBuffer all coexist. At the advertised 10MB that is roughly 34MB of peak memory for one add.

title: Error banner and selected-file label are light-only
detail: bg-red-50 / text-red-600 / border-red-100 and text-orange-900 carry no dark variants.

title: File validation rejects on MIME type alone
detail: A PDF whose type the OS reports as empty string is refused with 'Please select a valid PDF file' even though the accept filter allowed it, and a renamed non-PDF with a spoofed type passes.
